name: web-search-impl
description: The web-search@1 SERVICE HOST (provider `registry`): it owns the engine registry, the execution-time selection policy (explicit engine, else configured default + ordered fallback, else the single usable engine), the result bound (count cap, inline character cap, ranking) and the hand-over of a capped result set to spill@1. Engines are SEPARATE plugins that register themselves here; this plugin imports no engine. It performs no host execution (an engine owns its HTTP call), so the manifest declares execution none.

config.description: Which engine answers by default, the fallback chain, and the bounds of one answer.

provider.description: Default engine id (e.g. stub, tavily). Absent: take the single usable registered engine, or fail with web-search.ambiguous.

fallback.description: Ordered engine ids tried when the default cannot run (a dead chain is a typed error, never a silent switch).

count.description: Default result count of a call that names none.

maxCount.description: Hard ceiling of a caller-supplied count.

maxChars.description: Inline character cap of one answer; the overflow goes to spill@1 (and the answer says truncated).

spill.description: Hand the overflow of the character cap to spill@1. When no spill provider is loaded the answer still returns, with an explicit note that the rest was dropped.

timeoutMs.description: Deadline of one engine call (a timeout is a typed web-search.timeout error).
